name: Chorizo & tomato salad
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical side-salad portion size for 2 people given the listed ingredient quantities
Preparation time estimated from quick assembly and brief pan-frying steps
Gluten-free assumes no hidden gluten in chorizo (standard cured chorizo is usually GF)
Dairy-free based on absence of any dairy ingredients
No tree nuts, peanuts, sesame, soy, fish, shellfish, eggs or milk ingredients present
Thyme listed as fresh sprigs; conservatively treated as leaves only for classification
instructions:
step 1
Put the tomatoes in a bowl with the onion and thyme. Season, then drizzle with the vinegar and oil. Let the flavours mingle while you cook the chorizo.

step 2
In a hot, dry pan, fry the chorizo slices until browned on both sides. Serve the tomatoes with the fried chorizo, drizzled with a little oil from the pan.

ingredients.name: Beef tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: Medium-large beefsteak tomatoes, ~150g each; raw edible flesh only

ingredients.name: Red Onions
ingredients.assumptions: Half a medium red onion, ~110g total; raw

ingredients.name: Thyme
ingredients.assumptions: A few sprigs of fresh thyme leaves stripped (~5g usable leaves); typical fresh herb estimate

ingredients.name: Sherry vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tablespoon sherry vinegar, standard 15 ml volume

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, 15 ml each; full fat value for oil

ingredients.name: Chorizo
ingredients.assumptions: 100g chorizo sausage as given; typical cured Spanish-style values; pan-fried with fat rendered but total ingredient weight retained
